info.title: ResourceContracts MCP (petroleum & mining contracts)
info.description: No-auth MCP server over the ResourceContracts.org repository of petroleum and mining contracts (api.resourcecontracts.org; NRGI/CCSI, CC BY-SA 4.0). Tools: search_contracts, count_contracts, get_contract_metadata, get_contract_text (paginated by PDF page), get_contract_annotations (curated key clauses), list_countries, list_resources, list_years, list_annotation_categories. Use as a Copilot Studio custom MCP connector.
